slides.fact: _to sense owls in the bog_: to suspect that something fishy is going on.

slides.title: When would you say it?
slides.body:
When a deal sounds too good to be true, or the kids are suddenly very quiet. English might say _I smell a rat_.

You can also say *det finns ugglor i mossen*: there are owls in the bog.

slides.sv: Jag började *ana ugglor i mossen* när han inte svarade.
slides.en: I started to suspect something when he didn't answer.

caption:
Ana ugglor i mossen: to sense owls in the bog. It means suspecting that something isn't quite right.

If you're sure something is wrong, you can say "det finns ugglor i mossen": there are owls in the bog.

What animal would your language use?
